h1: The Grand Pool Villa Pattani — a private whole-house pool villa you can book for the entire family
intro: If you're coming to Pattani as a big group or a whole family and want a house all to yourselves — with a private pool for the kids and everyone under one roof rather than split across hotel floors — the name The Grand Pool Villa Pattani stands out fast · It's a 4-star private pool villa in the Rusamilae area on the outskirts of Pattani, rented as a whole house: 4 bedrooms, 5 bathrooms, around 400 sqm, sleeping roughly 17 guests, with a private saltwater pool, a full kitchen, free parking and CCTV around the property · Whole-house rates start at approx. ฿9,000/night · Real guest reviews love how spacious it is, the pool and the privacy — just allow for the out-of-town location and the need for a car.

body.html: The Grand Pool Villa Pattani is a private pool villa designed to be rented as a whole house, not a hotel let by the room · The house has 4 bedrooms and 5 bathrooms across roughly 400 square metres, sleeping around 17 comfortably, with room for small group gatherings or parties beyond that · Its main draw is the private saltwater pool in the middle of the house, a full kitchen with a dining area, and several living spaces where everyone can gather · It suits big families, groups of friends, or family reunions who want to stay together under one roof.

Inside, the house is decorated in a clean, airy modern style · All four bedrooms have air conditioning and most have en-suite bathrooms · The shared areas include a flat-screen TV, sofas and dining space both indoors and outdoors by the pool · What guests consistently praise is that the house is genuinely spacious, the pool is attractive and clean, and the kids can swim all day, plus the privacy of having no strangers walking past · There's free Wi-Fi throughout, free private parking for several cars, and CCTV around the property for peace of mind.

"The house is huge, the pool is clean and the kids swam all day, the kitchen is fully equipped so we cooked our own meals, and a big family stayed comfortably without feeling cramped — lots of parking and the owner looked after us well."

Because it's a whole-house rental with a full kitchen, many groups buy their own ingredients and cook by the pool, fire up a barbecue in the evening and sit around chatting for hours — an atmosphere ordinary hotels can't offer · There's an outdoor dining table looking over the pool and garden · For a family reunion or a birthday celebration it works well precisely because everyone is in the same house, with no walking between rooms on different floors.

Honestly, from real reviews: the thing to allow for is the location · The house is in the Rusamilae area on the outskirts of Pattani, about 5 km from the city centre — quiet and private, yes, but you'll need your own car or a ride to head into town for food or sightseeing, as there aren't many places within walking distance · It's also a newer property with relatively few public reviews; most information comes from the villa's own page and from groups who've stayed — so message ahead to confirm the maximum number of guests, the check-in/out times and the deposit before you transfer.

In short, if you're coming to Pattani as a big group or whole family and want an entire house with a private pool and full kitchen, and you're not set on being in the city centre, The Grand Pool Villa Pattani is a sensible choice that's good value split between several people · But if you're a couple, or you want to walk around the city without a car, renting the whole house probably isn't worth it or as convenient as a city hotel · It suits family trips, reunions, special occasions and groups of friends who want a house of their own for a night or two in Pattani.

A tip from following the reviews here: check the whole-house rate against your group size and dates first, since prices move with holidays and the number of guests — the more people sharing, the better the value · If you plan to cook, buy your ingredients in town before you arrive, as there are few shops nearby · And if you're a large group or planning an event at the house, confirm the maximum guest count and the rules on the pool and noise with the owner in advance to avoid any issues.

honestSummary: The Grand Pool Villa Pattani is a strong choice for anyone coming to Pattani as a group or whole family who wants an entire house with a private pool and full kitchen — spacious, private, and good value split between several people · But you have to accept that it's on the outskirts in the Rusamilae area, you'll need a car, and it's a newer property with few public reviews; it suits group trips more than couples who want to walk around the city.
honestChecks: If you're just two people or have no car — renting a whole house out of town may not be worth it or convenient → consider a hotel or boutique in central Pattani instead.

If you're a big group or whole family — a whole-house rental with 4 bedrooms, a private pool and full kitchen is exactly what this place does well → the more people sharing, the better the value, and you can cook your own meals.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — The Grand Pool Villa Pattani

faq.q: Where is The Grand Pool Villa Pattani, and what's nearby?
faq.a: The Grand Pool Villa Pattani is in the Rusamilae area of Mueang Pattani District, on the outskirts about 5 km from the city centre · It's near Prince of Songkla University's Pattani Campus and Rusamilae Beach · The location is quiet and private, but you'll want your own car for trips into town or to find food.

faq.q: How much does The Grand Pool Villa Pattani cost, and how do I book?
faq.a: It's a whole-house rental, with rates from approx. ฿9,000/night on weekdays, rising on holidays and for larger groups · Prices depend on guest numbers and dates, so the more people sharing the better the value · Compare rates on Agoda and Booking, or message the villa's page directly, and confirm the terms before booking.

faq.q: How many guests does The Grand Pool Villa Pattani sleep, and is there a private pool?
faq.a: The house has 4 bedrooms, 5 bathrooms and roughly 400 sqm, sleeping around 17, with room for larger group gatherings · There's a private saltwater pool in the middle of the house, a full kitchen with a dining area, free parking and CCTV around the property.

faq.q: Who is The Grand Pool Villa Pattani best for?
faq.a: It's best for big families, groups of friends and reunions who want to rent a whole house with a private pool and full kitchen · It suits small events and special-occasion celebrations · It's less suited to couples travelling as two, or anyone wanting to walk around the city without a car, since it's on the outskirts.

faq.q: Can I cook my own meals at The Grand Pool Villa Pattani?
faq.a: Yes · The house has a full kitchen with dining areas both indoors and by the pool, and many groups buy ingredients to cook their own meals and have a poolside barbecue · Buy your supplies in central Pattani before you arrive, as there are few shops nearby.

faq.q: What are the reviews like for The Grand Pool Villa Pattani?
faq.a: It's a newer property with relatively few public reviews · Guests who have stayed praise the spacious house, the clean private pool, the high privacy and the attentive owner · The main thing to allow for is the out-of-town location that requires a car, and it's worth confirming guest numbers and the deposit clearly before booking.
